role: Renders an EntityCaveSpider: RenderSpider's spider model at 0.7 scale with the cave spider texture and the same glowing-eyes overlay pass.
scope_reason: Cave spiders spawn in gated worlds and the mob scenes compare their pixels.

members.name: RenderCaveSpider
members.note: shadowSize *= 0.7 is folded into the shadow radius in raster_mobs.c draw_shadow's kind table

members.name: preRenderCallback
members.note: the 0.7 scale is applied in the shared vertex transform for MOB_CAVE_SPIDER

notes: The spider model itself and the additive eyes overlay (shouldRenderPass in RenderSpider, the superclass another record covers) are in raster_mobs.c model_spider and the TEX_SPIDER_EYES pass in raster_mobs_draw. The spider scenes gate both spider kinds.
